prose.en: Tori sets his right knee down at uke's right side, cradles uke's neck with his right arm from uke's left side, and clasps both hands together in front of uke's face. Uke's right arm is trapped between the two heads, and tori holds him down by pressing that arm with the right side of his own head.
Image of the entry and of the hold Tori enters and settles into kata-gatame. Tori holds uke down while controlling uke's right arm and head.
Uke rolls backwards and comes onto his front. Uke rolls backwards and turns face down.
Tori uses both legs to roll uke sideways into the hold. Tori uses both legs to turn uke over sideways and hold him down.

heading.en: Faults that are easy to fall into

prose.en: Tori should bend his knee and come up on his toes as he holds uke down.
If uke becomes distressed, he should not force it but should give the signal for *maitta* ("I give in").
